<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <SkiaNativeRid Condition="'$(SkiaNativeRid)' == '' and '$(RuntimeIdentifier)' != ''">$(RuntimeIdentifier)</SkiaNativeRid>
    <SkiaNativeRid Condition="'$(SkiaNativeRid)' == '' and '$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'">win-x64</SkiaNativeRid>
    <SkiaNativeRid Condition="'$(SkiaNativeRid)' == '' and '$([MSBuild]::IsOSPlatform(`Linux`))' == 'true'">linux-x64</SkiaNativeRid>
    <SkiaNativeRid Condition="'$(SkiaNativeRid)' == '' and '$([MSBuild]::IsOSPlatform(`OSX`))' == 'true'">osx</SkiaNativeRid>
    <!-- Tests resolve mod assets from repo mods/ via RepoModPaths; referenced mods share assets/* TargetPaths and race under -m. -->
    <GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex>[/\\]mods[/\\]</GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\**\*.*"
          Exclude="..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\*\native\libSkiaSharp.*"
          Link="runtimes\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)"
          CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(SkiaNativeRid)' != ''">
    <None Include="..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.dll"
          Link="libSkiaSharp.dll"
          CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest"
          Condition="Exists('..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.dll')" />
    <None Include="..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.so"
          Link="libSkiaSharp.so"
          CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest"
          Condition="Exists('..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.so')" />
    <None Include="..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.dylib"
          Link="libSkiaSharp.dylib"
          CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest"
          Condition="Exists('..\..\Libraries\SkiaSharp\runtimes\$(SkiaNativeRid)\native\libSkiaSharp.dylib')" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <Target Name="GasTests_ExcludeReferencedModAssetsFromOutputCopy"
          AfterTargets="GetCopyToOutputDirectoryItems"
          BeforeTargets="_CopyOutOfDateSourceItemsToOutputDirectory;_CopyOutOfDateSourceItemsToOutputDirectoryAlways;_CopyDifferingSourceItemsToOutputDirectory">
    <ItemGroup>
      <_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectory Remove="@(_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectory)"
          Condition="$([System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::IsMatch('%(Identity)', '$(GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex)'))" />
      <_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectoryAlways Remove="@(_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectoryAlways)"
          Condition="$([System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::IsMatch('%(Identity)', '$(GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex)'))" />
      <_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectoryIfDifferent Remove="@(_SourceItemsToCopyToOutputDirectoryIfDifferent)"
          Condition="$([System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::IsMatch('%(Identity)', '$(GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex)'))" />
      <AllItemsFullPathWithTargetPath Remove="@(AllItemsFullPathWithTargetPath)"
          Condition="$([System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::IsMatch('%(Identity)', '$(GasTestsReferencedModAssetPathRegex)'))" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
